description: Capabilities for the extension-tool popup (pet-panel machinery: floats over every app/Space). Needs window drag/maximize/hide (pet-panel-style titlebar with pin/fullscreen/close buttons), focus events for the unpinned blur-auto-hide, the extension-tool lifecycle commands, and the opener plugin for external links in the built-in translation popup. The built-in translation popup persists its prefs (~/.folyn/storage/translation.json) DIRECTLY via a narrowly-scoped fs grant ($HOME/.folyn/storage only — exists/mkdir/write-text-file, no read); cross-realm sync still flows through pet://settings-updated broadcasts and the main window's quit-time flush remains the safety net (v3: the broadcast-only path lost the popup's writes on any non-graceful exit — dev reload / Ctrl-C / crash).
